requirement: When `output.html.git-repository-url` names a GitHub repository and `output.html.edit-url-template` uses that repository's `/edit/<branch>/{path}` form, each safely resolved source location displayed for an evidence input MUST link its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob/<branch>/<file>#L<start>-L<end>`. A source location MUST remain plain text when a safe URL cannot be derived. A generated detail page MUST use its evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when the file exists, or its requirement chapter when the evidence file is missing.
rationale: I found no gaps. Each obligation has code carrying it out and a test that asserts its outcome. **Obligation 1: link each safely resolved source location to `/blob//#L-L` when the repository is on GitHub and the edit template uses `/edit//{path}`.** - `SourceLinks::from_config` (src/index.rs:46-86) reads both settings. It accepts only an `https://github.com//` repository and an edit template of the form `/edit//{path}`. It builds `blob_prefix` from the repository and branch. - `SourceLinks::input_url` (88-109) builds `/#L-L`. `encode_url_segment` (112-124) percent-encodes each path segment. - `render_source_location` (913-941) emits an `` around the `file:start–end` text when a URL exists. `render_input` calls it for each resolved range. - Test `source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch` (1501-1575) checks the exact URL, percent-encoding of `a b#c.rs`, and a full rendered page that contains the expected ``. **Obligation 2: the location stays plain text when no safe URL can be derived.** - `from_config` returns `None` when either setting is missing, when the repository is not GitHub or has an unsafe form, or when the template's repository or branch doesn't match. - `input_url` returns `None` for a zero or inverted range, for `..` or absolute paths, and for an empty path. - `render_source_location` falls back to a plain `` location when there is no URL. - The same test asserts `None` for a mismatched repository in the template, for a `javascript:` URL, for `../outside.rs`, and for start line 0. - `detail_page_renders_markdown_and_highlighted_input_sections` asserts the plain `- src/main.rs:1–4` rendering when `source_links` is `None`. It carries no `{test}` reference to this requirement, but its purpose is the `detail_format` requirement, so I did not count that as a marking gap. **Obligation 3: the detail page's edit target is the evidence JSON when that file exists, and the requirement chapter when it doesn't.** - `DetailPlan::populate` (src/index.rs:359-472) picks `evidence_edit_path(&config.book.src, name)` if `evidence_path.exists()`, and `definition.path` otherwise. It stores the choice in `page.source_path`. - `evidence_edit_path` (481-492) builds the `../…/evidence/.json` path. - Test `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts `../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json` for an existing record and `requirements/core.md` for the absent one. - `source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch` also tests `evidence_edit_path` with a nested book source directory. The `{impl}` comment inside `preprocess_book` in src/lib.rs sits on the reference-replacement block, which doesn't implement this requirement. Over-marking isn't a defined gap, so I did not count it.
